attempted_claim: For every fixed odd prime p and every ε>0, do there exist constants λ₀(p,ε) and C(p,ε) such that, for every n≥1 and every L²-normalized cuspidal Hecke–Maaß newform f of trivial nebentypus on Γ₀(p^{4n+2})\H with Laplace eigenvalue λ≥λ₀(p,ε), one has ‖f‖∞ ≤ C(p,ε)(p^{4n+2}λ)^{5/24+ε}?
decisive_failure: The investigation established a concrete depth-uniformity obstruction but could neither prove nor disprove the target hybrid bound; the bounded numerical recovery test models amplifier gain versus depth loss rather than a full trace-formula computation, and no independently valuable alternative claim was found.
